CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SEC
AS
BEGIN
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CLTCODE ORDER BY DATE_OPEN) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 
) A
)
----------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
,TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus AS 
(
SELECT DISTINCT
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL OR BSC.LASTUPDATED = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' 
          THEN CASE WHEN  GDC.DATE_OPEN IS NULL OR BSC.LASTUPDATED = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'  THEN  '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'
                    ELSE GDC.DATE_OPEN END
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BSC.CIVILSTAT AS MaritalStatusId
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.CLTTYPE = 'I'

)


SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,MaritalStatusId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,MaritalStatusId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC';


-------INSERT TO BNKM with update
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
(
     CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
     SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,NULL AS CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'



-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
(
     CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
     CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,NULL AS CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

END
